metadata.evidenceBoundary: Dossiers are bounded projections of retained public evidence. Observed-current professional roles are lower-bound observations, not appointment dates. Request, authority, obligation, outlay, award value, and ceiling measures remain separate. Missing public evidence is an explicit research gap, never a negative assertion.
metadata.selectionPolicy: The 100-dossier cohort prioritizes sourced leadership and oversight organizations, reviewed mission organizations, published budget sponsors, major buyers, and major vendors. Category quotas preserve breadth while deterministic ranking preserves high-value coverage.
